from lcss import longest_common_substring

tests = [
    (('', 'abc'), ''),

    (('programming', 'program'), 'program'),
    (('hello world', 'the world'), ' world'),
]

for (s1, s2), expected in tests:

    print(f'{status}: lcs({s1!r}, {s2!r}) = {result!r} (expected {expected!r})')
